task_changes: Replace reset/global-step command curriculum with periodic completed-episode aggregation

caveats: Summary excludes the warmup and all rows at/after the first reset.
Reset rows contain post-reset states. Reset reasons and pre-terminal states were not logged.
This play retains original noise/randomization/push events; it is not the nominal acceptance protocol.

interpretation_notes: Training reward and episode length are rolling training statistics, not held-out evaluation results.
Episode_Termination statistics summarize recent episode endings across training environments; they are not independent test success rates.
error_vel_xy and error_vel_yaw are command-resampling-time-normalized accumulated errors; they are not RMSE.
Recorded terrain curriculum ended at 0; broad difficult-terrain competence is not established.
Highest reward iteration is not necessarily the best checkpoint.
This is a 45D actor/60D critic/12 joint-action baseline. It is incompatible with direct loading into the 57D/5-action GPD residual model.
No new simulation, training, or policy updates were performed during collection.

caveats: First terminal state is captured before auto-reset. No subsequent episode is counted as recovery.
Nominal profile disables observation noise, external mass/material randomization and initial-state perturbations.
0.8 m/s is a separate stress case above the final training command curriculum.
Slip is contact-weighted RMS horizontal foot-link speed; not an exact measurement of contact-patch sliding.

conclusion: Curriculum expanded to 0.4 m/s, but deterministic forward walking still fails. Keep Gallop fine-tuning pending.
